description: Cluster 1 (Red): Foundational works on CSR behavior and ethics This group includes various authors such as Campbell et al. (2012), Graaflande et al. (Graafland et al. 2003), Font et al. (2016), Yoon et al. (2018), Hou (2019) and Seth and Mahenthiran (2022) who provide theoretical and ethical bases of CSR through their studies. Their research work is based on stakeholder obligations, moral footing of CSR in family businesses and enterprises, and normative frameworks.
